$comment: Descriptions for scripts/add --list. Files and dependencies come from src/ itself; scripts/add --check fails when a component has no description here.
name: lucy

components.alert: A box that calls attention to a message
components.avatar: A player's headshot, or a monogram for a bot
components.button: Button with variants, sizes and an optional key hint
components.icon: Small picture in the theme's colours, by name or asset id
components.image: Picture from an asset id or a thumbnail
components.item: List row with media, title, description and actions
components.kbd: The key to press for the player's keyboard or controller
components.panel: Card with header, content and footer
components.progress: Bar that fills from 0 to a maximum
components.radio-group: Options where the player picks exactly one
components.scroll-area: Region that scrolls when its content does not fit
components.stack: Row or column that lays out its children
components.switch: On and off switch with optional label
components.tabs: Tab bar with one panel per tab
components.toggle: Button that stays pressed until clicked again
components.toggle-group: Toggles where the player picks one or several
